[[File:Icon_of_the_Moon_Goddess.png|75px|thumb|The Icon of the Moon Goddess]]
The '''Icon of the [[Moon Goddess/Legends|Moon Goddess]]''' was a religious idol belonging to [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]]. It was cylindrical in shape and had a blue-painted moon on its crest. Papanoida kept it in a shrine in his [[Papanoida's Coruscant apartment|apartment]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. His daughter, [[Che Amanwe Papanoida/Legends|Che Amanwe Papanoida]], used it to defend herself from kidnappers during which a blood stain was left on the idol which led to her retrieval by her father.
